official: 中野区児童福祉施設の設備及び運営の基準に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第3回定例会 議案一覧

name: 児童福祉施設に性暴力防止措置を追加
summary: 条例に、児童対象性暴力等の防止と、発生した場合に児童を保護するための規定を加えます。助産施設など一部を除く児童福祉施設の設置者に、児童と接する仕事のうち、支配性・継続性・閉鎖性のある環境で接する人について、犯罪事実確認などの措置を求めます。令和8年12月25日に施行します。
changes: 児童対象性暴力等を防ぐため、犯罪事実確認などの措置を義務付ける
児童対象性暴力等が起きた場合に、児童を適切に保護する措置を求める
who: 対象となる児童福祉施設の設置者
対象となる業務に従事する人
対象施設を利用する児童
why: 児童福祉施設の設備及び運営に関する基準の改正に伴い、規定を整備する必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Adds measures to prevent sexual violence against children at child welfare facilities
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Nakano City Ordinance on Standards for Equipment and Operation of Child Welfare Facilities
en.summary: The ordinance adds provisions to prevent sexual violence and other acts against children, and to protect children if such an incident occurs. It requires the entities that establish child welfare facilities, except for some facilities such as maternity homes, to take measures including criminal record checks for people whose work involves contact with children in settings involving power imbalances, ongoing contact, and limited openness. It will take effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Require criminal record checks and other measures to prevent sexual violence and other acts against children
Require measures to protect children appropriately if sexual violence and other acts against children occur
who: Entities that establish the covered child welfare facilities
People engaged in the covered work
Children who use the covered facilities
en.why: The ward says the provisions need to be revised because the standards for the equipment and operation of child welfare facilities have been amended.
